title: fix(console): the docs portal renders the book resolver's answer; the Uncategorized pre-filter is retired (objectui#11340)
body:
Fixes #11340

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The portal now renders the book resolver's answer, with no pre-filter in front of it. This follows the triage ruling in comment `5925851232`: one authority for book membership (ADR-0046 §6.4).

- **Resolver.** The console's port of `resolveBookTree` (`apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts`) now scopes its synthetic Uncategorized group to the book's own packages. Those are the book's (`bookPackage`, else `book.packageId`) and each group's `package`, asked through `include`'s own scope test. The framework's resolver does the same since objectstack-ai/objectstack#20980 (`@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0).
- **Pre-filter.** `scopeDocsToBook` is deleted, and so is its helper `bookPackages`, which nothing else read.
- **Callers.** `BookPage`, `DocPage`, `countBookDocs` and `findBookContainingDoc` now resolve over every doc they read.

No export, prop, type member or i18n key of any `@object-ui/*` package is added or removed.

## Landing site, and why the route differs from the suggested one

The landing site is the expected one: `book-nav.ts`, `BookPage.tsx`, `DocPage.tsx` and the tests beside them.

**Mechanism assumption 2 is half true.** The portal does call its resolver with two arguments. But that resolver is the console's **local port**: the `book-nav.ts` header calls it "a faithful local port of the framework's `resolveBookTree`". It is not the spec's export. The port already defaults its scope to `book.packageId`, so passing the book's package at each call site, the suggested route, changes nothing.

**The hazard is real, by another mechanism.** Upstream's fix never reached the port, so the port's orphan pass was unscoped. Deleting the pre-filter alone widens Uncategorized to every package's docs (column (b) below). The fix ports upstream's orphan scope into the local resolver, then deletes the pre-filter.

**Why port it rather than call the spec's export.** The port and the spec read a doc's package differently.
- The port reads it through `pkgOf`: the `_packageId` stamp, else the prefix of the doc's name.
- The spec reads the stamp only, and treats an unstamped doc as inside every scope.

The port also marks the synthetic group (`synthetic`), which `countBookDocs` and `findBookContainingDoc` read. Calling the spec's export would also change what unstamped docs do in `include`, a visible change the ruling does not cover. Ported with `pkgOf`, an unstamped doc behaves as it did under the pre-filter.

## Measured: before and after

Probe at base `fd060f0767`, with the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0. Every doc carries a `packageId`, except in the last row. The columns:
- (a) the portal at base: pre-filter, then port;
- (b) the port alone, with no pre-filter, at base;
- (c) the spec's `resolveBookTree`, with the book's package as its third argument.

| Shape | (a) portal at base | (b) port alone | (c) spec 17.6.0 | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Control: crm book, group `start` includes `crm_intro`; docs `crm_intro`, `crm_stray` (crm), `ops_keys` (ops) | Uncategorized: `crm_stray` | Uncategorized: `crm_stray`, `ops_keys` | Uncategorized: `crm_stray` | = (c) |
| Corner 1: group `ext` with `package: b`; unplaced `b_note` (b) and `c_note` (c) | Uncategorized: `b_note` | `b_note`, `c_note` | `b_note` | = (c), unchanged |
| Corner 2: a group whose `pages` are `crm_intro`, `ops_keys`; `ops_keys` is labelled Keys | `ops_keys`, no label | `ops_keys` labelled Keys; `ops_other` in Uncategorized | `ops_keys` labelled Keys | = (c) |
| A book with no package; groups `all` (`include: '*'`) and `ext` (`package: b`) | `all`: `b_1` | `all`: `a_1`, `b_1` | `all`: `a_1`, `b_1` | = (c) |
| Another package's doc whose `group` names a `pages` group that has no `...` | in Uncategorized | in Uncategorized | absent | = (c) |
| An unstamped doc `ops_unstamped` beside a crm book | absent | in Uncategorized | in Uncategorized | absent, as (a); see Acceptance notes |

- **Corner 1 is not a visible change.** The card's premise, that the pre-filter drops a group package's unplaced docs, is false: `bookPackages` included each group's `package`.
- **Corner 2 and the next two rows are visible changes.** The changeset names all of them, and Corner 1 as unchanged.

## Tests

- **`book-nav.uncategorizedScope-11340.test.ts` (new).** The control pair, Corner 1, Corner 2, a package-less book, and the two further shapes. Every case also asserts that the portal's full tree equals the spec's `resolveBookTree` over the same docs, scoped by the book's package. That covers every group, Uncategorized included.
- **`docs-portal.uncategorizedScope-11340.test.tsx` (new).** The rendered sidebar, through the real route table (DocsLayout, DocPage, BookSidebar). It pins the control pair, Corner 1, and Corner 2, whose link is named by the doc's own label.
- **`book-nav.explicitGroup-11245.test.ts`, re-judged.** `portalTree` is now `resolveBookTree(b, all)`. Everything it pins about explicit `group` placement stands. Its controls are now held by the resolver's own orphan scope: ablation A below turns them red.
- **`book-nav.test.ts`, re-judged.** Its package-scope case pinned the old unscoped orphan: `b_x` sat in the Uncategorized group of a book that draws from package `a` alone. It now pins the resolver's answer, which has no Uncategorized group. The "drops nothing" case is renamed to say it concerns a book that declares no package.

**Runs on the merge commit `81136e7`** (origin/main `b403bb36f` merged in):
- The five book-nav and docs-portal files: 37 passed on `a36dbd7`, before the merge, and again inside the full console run below.
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/` (the root spelling): 147 test files passed, 1761 tests passed, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` after a turbo build of `@object-ui/console^...`: exit 0. The build was 34 of 34 tasks. `--listFiles` shows all seven touched files in the run.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console lint`: exit 0, 0 errors. The warnings in `DocPage.tsx` are on lines this PR does not touch.

**Reverse verification.** The base implementation of `book-nav.ts`, `BookPage.tsx` and `DocPage.tsx` was put back from `fd060f0767`, with the new pins kept. Result: 4 failed, 5 passed.
- Red: the unit control, unit Corner 1 and unit `pages`-group case, and the rendered Corner 2, whose link was named `ops_keys` rather than Keys.
- Still green: the rendered control and rendered Corner 1. That is the expected direction: the pre-filter already produced those two answers on base.
- Restore: each blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**Ablations** on the committed fix `a36dbd7`, through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. In each, the anchor went from 1 hit to 0, the blob changed, the file was restored to equal HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- **A: the orphan-scope filter line deleted.** 8 failed, 29 passed across the five files. Red: both new controls, unit Corner 1, the `pages`-group case, both 11245 controls, the 11245 group-`package` case, and the `book-nav.test.ts` package-scope case.
- **B: group packages dropped from the orphan scope.** 3 failed: unit Corner 1, rendered Corner 1, and the `book-nav.test.ts` package-scope case.

**Gates**, run locally, each exit 0:
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`;
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` and `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`;
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` and `pnpm check:new-line-citations`;
- `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit` and `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape`;
- `pnpm check:installed-pin-claims` and `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources`.

`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` answers NOT GOVERNED for all eight paths. CI runs the full farm.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Unstamped docs (observation; not filed; no carrier).** The port reads a doc's package with `pkgOf`, which falls back to the name's prefix. The spec treats a doc with no `_packageId` as inside every scope, in `include` and now in the orphan pass. The `include` half of that divergence predates this PR. This PR keeps the portal's reading for orphans, so nothing changes for unstamped docs. Whether runtime-saved docs reach the portal without `_packageId` was not measured here.
2. **Doc editor hint (observation; not filed; no carrier).** The doc editor preview in `packages/app-shell` says "Not in any book section yet — book trees list it under Uncategorized." Since spec 17.6.0, a doc whose package has no book is in no book's Uncategorized group. This is read from the code and was not measured at the editor.
3. **Gate spelling.** The dispatch spelled the typecheck gate `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console typecheck`. The console's script is `type-check`, and a filtered run that matches no script exits 0. This PR ran `type-check`.
